Haq, Vinay Joshi 1/2 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay Nagpur Bench, Nagpur. Criminal Application (Apl) No. 254/2019 (Laxman S/o Motilal Shahu Vs. State of Maharashtra & anr.) ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Office notes, Office Memoranda of Coram, appearances, Court's orders Court's or Judge' or directions and Registrar's orders. ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Shri S. A. Mohta, Advocate for applicant. Shri T.A. Mirza, App for respondents. Coram : Z. A. Haq & Vinay Joshi, Jj. Date : 16.04.2019.
texts.facts: (i) The learned APP on instructions submits that, in terms of the provisions of Section 38(1)(c) proviso of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 necessary bond with an undertaking would be taken from the petitioner herein.
texts.arguments: (ii) The learned advocate for the petitioner, on instructions, submits that the petitioner is ready to execute the bond in terms of Section 38(1)(c) proviso of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and is also ready to file an undertaking to the effect that in future he would not keep contraband articles like Gutkha etc. in his grocery shop and he will not use his shop for selling those articles in future.
texts.petitioner_arguments: (ii) The learned advocate for the petitioner, on instructions, submits that the petitioner is ready to execute the bond in terms of Section 38(1)(c) proviso of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and is also ready to file an undertaking to the effect that in future he would not keep contraband articles like Gutkha etc. in his grocery shop and he will not use his shop for selling those articles in future.
